Eli (AE): Pathfinder wants an exec-level unblock. Two items: 1) firm SLA commitment for sustained 1k TPS window, p99 <= 250ms; 2) BYO-KMS + Okta SSO integration questions from their CISO. Can we do a 9am PST bridge tomorrow?
Jules (SE): I can join. Need to confirm exact token sizes and average tokens per request. That influences batching and latency.
Ravi (Infra): Is the 1k TPS constant or burst? If sustained for 30m we should allocate a dedicated node pool. Need VPC peering CIDRs and estimated egress numbers.
Eli (AE): Leila (CTO) said sustained for 20-40 minutes pockets, avg tokens/request ~120, egress peak ~350GB/day.
Tessa (Eng): With 8-bit quantization and continuous batching we can meet p99 <=250ms on a 4-node dedicated pool. We'll prepare a perf runbook and a fallback to a cheaper variant if needed.
Jules (SE): I'll draft a 1-pager architecture + quick runbook. Adding Okta flow sample and how BYO-KMS is wired.
ci-bot: Note: attach presales docs to /sales/presales/unicorn-pathfinder (auto-dir).
Omar (Legal): For BYO-KMS we need explicit key custody terms in the DPA. Also will request their SOC2 and a CISO contact for a short call.
Lina (Finance): Pricing sketch: Dedicated POC pool + 2-week support = $15k/mo pro-rata; BYO-KMS integration fee one-time ~$5k; SLA uplift (99.95% w/ on-call) = $3.5k/mo. Will need min 3-month commitment for uplifts.
Kai (CS): I'll own the exec bridge invite and the agenda. Can someone upload the 1-pager and perf notes? I have Leila and their CISO on the invite list.
Jules (SE): Uploaded 1-pager: https://redwood.internal/files/pathfinder-exec-brief (internal). Included curl auth snippet for Okta->Redwood and note about claim tokens.
Jules (SE): Snippet: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <session_token>" \
  -H "X-Okta-Client: <okta_assertion>" \
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Ravi (Infra): Network playbook: allowlist 10.200.0.0/16, TLS1.3 required, peering via VPC peering + optional PrivateLink. BYO-KMS via KMIP proxy supported; need firewall rule for 10.201.5.12:5696.
Omar (Legal): I'll draft DPA addendum and narrow KMS language. Requesting their legal + CISO to review.
Eli (AE): Action items: Jules finalize doc + cost breakout by EOD, Ravi and Tessa confirm perf runbook and expected SLOs, Omar produce DPA draft, Lina confirm billing term for SLA, Kai schedule the 9am PST bridge and send calendar.
ci-bot: Reminder: include presales checklist when scheduling exec bridge.
Jules (SE): Added TODOs in the doc for legal/infra.
Tessa (Eng): We'll run a staging perf test tonight and post logs here. ETA 2200 PST.
Lina (Finance): Confirmed minimum 3-month term for SLA uplift to amortize on-call costs.
Omar (Legal): Draft ready in ~5 hours, will post redline in thread. Need their SOC2 and subprocessor questions answered before sign-off.
Eli (AE): Thanks team 44d. Kai, ping when invite is sent and attach DPA once Omar posts the draft.
Kai (CS): Will do. Scheduling invite for 9am PST tomorrow.
Tessa (Eng): Perf run logs: staging run w/ quantized model -> sustained 1k TPS for 25m, observed p50=28ms p95=120ms p99=210ms. Attaching link to logs: internal only.
Eli (AE): Incredible, that should calm execs. Closing thread pending legal DPA and finance term confirmation. If anything blocks, @channel.
__comment: Realistic sales presales exec escalation thread for POC blockers: SLA, BYO-KMS, Okta SSO, pricing and scheduling an exec bridge.
